name: The Wheel (theta-gang style)
style_summary: Sell cash-secured puts on quality stocks you'd be happy to own; if assigned, sell covered calls against the shares. Collect option premium (theta) over and over rather than betting on direction.
mechanics: The wheel: sell a cash-secured put -> keep premium if it expires OTM and repeat -> if assigned, buy 100 shares -> sell covered calls above cost basis -> repeat until called away.

selection_rules: Only stocks you'd be happy to own ('sell on stocks you'd own')
Share price $20-$300; avoid penny stocks under $5

entry.trigger: Open a cash-secured put on a qualifying underlying when IV rank is elevated.
entry.dte: 30-45 (weeklies 7-14 for active traders; up to 45-60 for patient)
entry.delta_or_strike: CSP: ~0.30 delta (0.20-0.30 conservative, up to 0.40-0.50 aggressive). CC: strike 5-10% above cost basis.

exit.profit_target: Close at 50% of max profit when 21+ DTE remain (some hold to 80%).
exit.roll_rules: At 50% profit with 21+ DTE, close and roll. Roll puts down-and-out when ITM to avoid assignment; roll calls up-and-out when shares are threatened with early assignment.
exit.assignment_handling: Accept assignment on stocks you wanted; buy 100 shares (cost basis = strike - premium) and switch to selling covered calls.
exit.stop_or_line_in_sand: Define profit target AND exit ('line in the sand') before entering — number not specified by source.

cadence: Weekly — act around expiries and check each market open for rolls/assignments.
risk_notes: Diversify across many underlyings and don't oversize any one name.
Only wheel names you'd hold through a drawdown, since assignment means owning them.
Avoid names with IV > 80 — high premium there usually reflects real fundamental risk.

conflicts.resolution: Defaulted to the more conservative 5%; flag for organizer to confirm.
Left as a range; organizer to set their house number.

gaps: No concrete numeric stop / 'line in the sand' given, only that one should exist.
No rule for earnings/events (many wheelers avoid holding through earnings) — source silent.
Covered-call delta target not given (only '5-10% above cost basis').

disclaimer: Educational tool, not personalized investment advice. Runs on the member's own account with their own risk limits and hold-to-approve execution.
